query: Which semi-supervised methods (label spreading, propagation, self-training, Mean Teacher) and confidence/consistency rules should be prioritized given limited labeled fault events?

response.query: Which semi-supervised methods (label spreading, propagation, self-training, Mean Teacher) and confidence/consistency rules should be prioritized given limited labeled fault events?
response.answer: Prioritize label spreading and self-training for limited labeled data; Mean Teacher and consistency rules can also be useful. These methods effectively leverage unlabeled data.
